longBusinessSummary: Russel Metals Inc. engages in the distribution of steel and other metal products in Canada and the United States. The company operates through Metals Service Centers, Energy Field Stores, and Steel Distribution segments. The Metal Service Centers segment operates a network of metals service centers, which provide metal products in various sizes, shapes, and specifications, including carbon hot rolled and cold finished steel, pipe and tubular, stainless steel, aluminum, and other non-ferrous specialty metal products. The Energy Field Stores segment offers specialized products, such as flanges, valves, fittings, and other products to energy industry. The Steel Distributors segment sells steel products comprising carbon steel plate, flat rolled products, beams, channels, and pipes to other steel service centers and equipment manufacturers.
